## Jiongeze Learning Journey

This page provides an overview of the complete Jiongeze pathway.

The journey moves from understanding, to learning, to action, and eventually to contribution.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR

A[Foundation] --> B[Learning]
B --> C[Journey]
C --> D[Projects]
D --> E[Resources]
E --> F[Growth]
```
